definition: Both direct PID heads are evaluated on the beta baseline's exact held-out rows; teacher responses are empirical fractions and model responses are mean softmax probabilities.

original_checkpoint.selection_sql:
rec_detector_region = 'FD'
      AND rec_theta < radians(33.0)
      AND gen_vz > -5.5
      AND gen_vz < -0.5
      AND usable_for_hadron_response_training
      AND gen_pid IN (-211, 211, 2212)
      AND delta_p IS NOT NULL AND delta_theta IS NOT NULL AND delta_phi IS NOT NULL
      AND isfinite(delta_p) AND isfinite(delta_theta) AND isfinite(delta_phi)
      AND match_reciprocal
      AND rec_pid <> 0
      AND rec_beta > -99
      AND abs(delta_p) <= 10.0

beta_checkpoint.selection_sql:
rec_detector_region = 'FD'
      AND rec_theta < radians(33.0)
      AND gen_vz > -5.5
      AND gen_vz < -0.5
      AND usable_for_hadron_response_training
      AND gen_pid IN (-211, 211, 2212)
      AND delta_p IS NOT NULL AND delta_theta IS NOT NULL AND delta_phi IS NOT NULL
      AND isfinite(delta_p) AND isfinite(delta_theta) AND isfinite(delta_phi)
      AND match_reciprocal
      AND rec_pid <> 0
      AND rec_beta > -99
      AND isfinite(rec_beta)
      AND rec_beta > 0.0
      AND rec_beta <= 1.2
      AND abs(delta_p) <= 10.0

caveat: Same-test comparison only. Training selections, continuous target dimensions, and selected early-stopping epochs differ.
